Data preparation train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv") test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv") train_df, val_df = train_test_split( train_df, test_size=0.1, stratify=train_df["diagnosis"], random_state=42 ) # Class weights calculation pos_weights = [] for k in range(4): pos = (train_df["diagnosis"] > k).sum() neg = len(train_df) - pos pos_weights.append(neg / (pos + 1e-7)) pos_weights = torch.tensor(pos_weights, dtype=torch.float32).to(device) # Augmentations train_transform = A.Compose( [ A.Resize(IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE), A.HorizontalFlip(p=0.5), A.VerticalFlip(p=0.5), A.RandomRotate90(p=0.5), A.ShiftScaleRotate(shift_limit=0.1, scale_limit=0.1, rotate_limit=20, p=0.5), A.RandomBrightnessContrast(p=0.5, brightness_limit=0.2, contrast_limit=0.2), A.HueSaturationValue( p=0.5, hue_shift_limit=10, sat_shift_limit=20, val_shift_limit=10 ), A.CoarseDropout(p=0.5, max_holes=8, max_height=32, max_width=32), A.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]), ToTensorV2(), ] ) test_transform = A.Compose( [ A.Resize(IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE), A.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]), ToTensorV2(), ] ) class RetinaDataset(Dataset): def __init__(self, df, img_dir, transform=None, is_test=False): self.df = df self.img_dir = img_dir self.transform = transform self.is_test = is_test def __len__(self): return len(self.df) def __getitem__(self, idx): img_name = f"{self.img_dir}/{self.df.iloc[idx]['id_code']}.png" image = np.array(Image.open(img_name).convert("RGB")) if self.transform: augmented = self.transform(image=image) image = augmented["image"] if self.is_test: return image label = self.df.iloc[idx]["diagnosis"] targets = torch.tensor([label > k for k in range(4)], dtype=torch.float32) return image, targets, label # Data loading train_dataset = RetinaDataset(train_df, "./input/train_images", train_transform) val_dataset = RetinaDataset(val_df, "./input/train_images", test_transform) test_dataset = RetinaDataset( test_df, "./input/test_images", test_transform, is_test=True ) train_loader = DataLoader( train_dataset, BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, num_workers=8, pin_memory=True ) val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, BATCH_SIZE, num_workers=8, pin_memory=True) test_loader = DataLoader(test_dataset, BATCH_SIZE, num_workers=8, pin_memory=True) # Model setup model = timm.create_model("tf_efficientnet_b4", pretrained=True, num_classes=4) model = model.to(device) criterion = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss(pos_weight=pos_weights) optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=3e-4, weight_decay=1e-4) scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.OneCycleLR( optimizer, max_lr=3e-4, total_steps=EPOCHS * len(train_loader) ) # Training loop best_kappa = -1 for epoch in range(EPOCHS): model.train() for images, targets, _ in train_loader: images, targets = images.to(device), targets.to(device) optimizer.zero_grad() outputs = model(images) loss = criterion(outputs, targets) loss.backward() nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 5.0) optimizer.step() scheduler.step() model.eval() val_preds, val_true = [], [] with torch.no_grad(): for images, _, labels in val_loader: outputs = model(images.to(device)) preds = (torch.sigmoid(outputs) >= 0.5).sum(1) val_preds.extend(preds.cpu().numpy()) val_true.extend(labels.numpy()) kappa = cohen_kappa_score(val_true, val_preds, weights="quadratic") print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{EPOCHS} | Val Kappa: {kappa:.4f}") if kappa > best_kappa: best_kappa = kappa torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pth") print(f"Best Validation Kappa: {best_kappa:.4f}") # Threshold optimization model.load_state_dict(torch.load("./working/best_model.pth")) model.eval() val_outputs = [] val_true = [] with torch.no_grad(): for images, _, labels in val_loader: images = images.to(device) outputs = model(images) val_outputs.append(torch.sigmoid(outputs).cpu().numpy()) val_true.append(labels.numpy()) val_outputs = np.concatenate(val_outputs) val_true = np.concatenate(val_true) best_thresholds = [] for k in range(4): y_true = (val_true > k).astype(int) y_scores = val_outputs[:, k] best_t = 0.5 best_kappa = -1 for t in np.linspace(0.1, 0.9, 81): y_pred = (y_scores >= t).astype(int) kappa = cohen_kappa_score(y_true, y_pred) if kappa > best_kappa: best_kappa = kappa best_t = t best_thresholds.append(best_t) print( f"Optimal threshold for task {k}: {best_t:.4f} (binary kappa={best_kappa:.4f})" ) # Generate submission with optimized thresholds test_preds = [] with torch.no_grad(): for images in test_loader: images = images.to(device) outputs = model(images) outputs = torch.sigmoid(outputs).cpu().numpy() preds = (outputs >= best_thresholds).sum(axis=1) test_preds.extend(preds) os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True) submission = pd.DataFrame({"id_code": test_df.id_code, "diagnosis": test_preds}) submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False) print("Submission file created with optimized thresholds")

class FocalLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, alpha=None, gamma=2, reduction="mean"):
        super(FocalLoss, self).__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.reduction = reduction

    def forward(self, inputs, targets):
        ce_loss = F.cross_entropy(inputs, targets, reduction="none", weight=self.alpha)
        pt = torch.exp(-ce_loss)
        focal_loss = (1 - pt) ** self.gamma * ce_loss
        if self.reduction == "mean":
            return focal_loss.mean()
        elif self.reduction == "sum":
            return focal_loss.sum()
        return focal_loss

# Augmentations
train_transform = A.Compose(
    [
        A.Resize(384, 384),
        A.CLAHE(p=0.5),
        A.HorizontalFlip(p=0.5),
        A.VerticalFlip(p=0.5),
        A.Rotate(limit=30, p=0.5),
        A.RandomBrightnessContrast(p=0.3),
        A.GridDistortion(p=0.2),
        A.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
        ToTensorV2(),
    ]
)

val_transform = A.Compose(
    [
        A.Resize(384, 384),
        A.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
        ToTensorV2(),
    ]
)


class RetinaDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, img_dir, transform=None):
        self.df = df
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.transform = transform

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        row = self.df.iloc[idx]
        img_id = row["id_code"]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.img_dir, f"{img_id}.png")
        image = cv2.imread(img_path)
        image = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
        if self.transform:
            image = self.transform(image=image)["image"]
        return image, row["diagnosis"]


# Model with CORAL ordinal regression
class ConvNeXtCORAL(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=5):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = timm.create_model(
            "convnext_base", pretrained=True, num_classes=0
        )
        self.fc = nn.Linear(self.backbone.num_features, num_classes - 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        features = self.backbone(x)
        return self.fc(features)


class CoralLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.criterion = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()

    def forward(self, outputs, targets):
        batch_size = targets.size(0)
        levels = torch.arange(self.num_classes - 1, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
        labels = (targets.view(-1, 1) > levels).float()
        return self.criterion(outputs, labels)

        )
        self.fc = nn.Linear(self.backbone.num_features, num_classes - 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        features = self.backbone(x)
        return self.fc(features)

    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.criterion = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()

        batch_size = targets.size(0)
        levels = torch.arange(self.num_classes - 1, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
        labels = (targets.view(-1, 1) > levels).float()
        return self.criterion(outputs, labels)

class CumulativeLinkModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=5):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = timm.create_model(
            "vit_base_patch16_384", pretrained=True, num_classes=0
        )
        self.fc = nn.Linear(self.backbone.num_features, num_classes - 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        features = self.backbone(x)
        logits = self.fc(features)
        return logits


def cumulative_link_loss(logits, targets):
    batch_size = targets.size(0)
    targets = targets.view(-1, 1)
    logits = logits.view(batch_size, -1)

    cum_probs = torch.sigmoid(logits)
    one_minus_cum = 1 - cum_probs

    mask = targets.expand(-1, logits.size(1)).ge(
        torch.arange(4, device=logits.device) + 1
    )
    left_probs = torch.where(mask, cum_probs, one_minus_cum)
    return -torch.log(left_probs + 1e-12).mean()

class CumulativeLinkModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=5):
        super().__init__()
        self.features = timm.create_model(
            "efficientnet_b0", pretrained=True, num_classes=0
        )
        self.fc = nn.Linear(self.features.num_features, num_classes - 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        features = self.features(x)
        logits = self.fc(features)
        return logits


def cumulative_link_loss(logits, targets):
    batch_size = targets.size(0)
    targets = targets.view(-1, 1)
    logits = logits.view(batch_size, -1)

    cum_probs = torch.sigmoid(logits)
    one_minus_cum = 1 - cum_probs

    mask = targets.expand(-1, logits.size(1)).ge(
        torch.arange(4, device=logits.device) + 1
    )
    left_probs = torch.where(mask, cum_probs, one_minus_cum)
    return -torch.log(left_probs + 1e-12).mean()

class FocalLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, alpha=None, gamma=2, reduction="mean"):
        super(FocalLoss, self).__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.reduction = reduction

        elif self.reduction == "sum":
            return focal_loss.sum()
        return focal_loss

class CumulativeLinkModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=5):
        super().__init__()
        self.features = timm.create_model("resnet50", pretrained=True, num_classes=0)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(self.features.num_features, num_classes - 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        features = self.features(x)
        logits = self.fc(features)
        return logits


def cumulative_link_loss(logits, targets):
    batch_size = targets.size(0)
    targets = targets.view(-1, 1)
    logits = logits.view(batch_size, -1)

    cum_probs = torch.sigmoid(logits)
    one_minus_cum = 1 - cum_probs

    mask = targets.expand(-1, logits.size(1)).ge(
        torch.arange(4, device=logits.device) + 1
    )
    left_probs = torch.where(mask, cum_probs, one_minus_cum)
    return -torch.log(left_probs + 1e-12).mean()

class FocalLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, alpha=None, gamma=2, reduction="mean"):
        super(FocalLoss, self).__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.reduction = reduction

    def forward(self, inputs, targets):
        ce_loss = F.cross_entropy(inputs, targets, reduction="none", weight=self.alpha)
        pt = torch.exp(-ce_loss)
        focal_loss = (1 - pt) ** self.gamma * ce_loss
        if self.reduction == "mean":
            return focal_loss.mean()
        return focal_loss

    def __init__(self, num_classes=5):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = timm.create_model(
            "efficientnet_b5", pretrained=True, num_classes=0
        )
        self.fc = nn.Linear(self.backbone.num_features, num_classes - 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        features = self.backbone(x)
        return self.fc(features)


def cumulative_link_loss(logits, targets):
    targets = targets.view(-1, 1)
    logits = logits.view(len(targets), -1)
    mask = targets >= torch.arange(4, device=targets.device) + 1
    probs = torch.where(mask, torch.sigmoid(logits), 1 - torch.sigmoid(logits))
    return -torch.log(probs + 1e-8).mean()

        )

    targets = targets.view(-1, 1)

    probs = torch.where(mask, torch.sigmoid(logits), 1 - torch.sigmoid(logits))

class FocalLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, alpha=None, gamma=2, reduction="mean"):
        super(FocalLoss, self).__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.reduction = reduction

    def forward(self, inputs, targets):
        ce_loss = F.cross_entropy(inputs, targets, reduction="none", weight=self.alpha)
        pt = torch.exp(-ce_loss)
        focal_loss = (1 - pt) ** self.gamma * ce_loss
        if self.reduction == "mean":
            return focal_loss.mean()
        return focal_loss

class RetinaDataset(Dataset):

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = timm.create_model(
            "efficientnet_b5", pretrained=True, num_classes=0
        )
        self.fc = nn.Linear(self.backbone.num_features, 4)

    def forward(self, x):
        features = self.backbone(x)
        return self.fc(features)


def cumulative_link_loss(logits, targets):
    targets = targets.view(-1, 1)
    logits = logits.view(len(targets), -1)
    mask = targets >= torch.arange(4, device=targets.device) + 1
    probs = torch.where(mask, torch.sigmoid(logits), 1 - torch.sigmoid(logits))
    return -torch.log(probs + 1e-8).mean()

class FocalLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, alpha=None, gamma=2, reduction="mean"):
        super(FocalLoss, self).__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.reduction = reduction

    def forward(self, inputs, targets):
        if targets.dim() == 1:
            targets = F.one_hot(targets, num_classes=inputs.size(1)).float()

        probs = F.softmax(inputs, dim=1)
        focal_loss = -(
            targets * (1 - probs) ** self.gamma * torch.log(probs + 1e-8)
        ).sum(dim=1)

        if self.alpha is not None:
            class_weights = (targets * self.alpha.view(1, -1)).sum(dim=1)
            focal_loss *= class_weights

        return focal_loss.mean() if self.reduction == "mean" else focal_loss.sum()

class FocalLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, alpha=None, gamma=2, reduction="mean"):
        super(FocalLoss, self).__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.reduction = reduction

    def forward(self, inputs, targets):
        if targets.dim() == 1:
            targets = F.one_hot(targets, num_classes=inputs.size(1)).float()

        probs = F.softmax(inputs, dim=1)
        focal_loss = -(
            targets * (1 - probs) ** self.gamma * torch.log(probs + 1e-8)
        ).sum(dim=1)

        if self.alpha is not None:
            class_weights = (targets * self.alpha.view(1, -1)).sum(dim=1)
            focal_loss *= class_weights

        return focal_loss.mean() if self.reduction == "mean" else focal_loss.sum()

    def __init__(self, alpha=None, gamma=2, reduction="mean"):
        super(FocalLoss, self).__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.reduction = reduction

            focal_loss *= class_weights

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
train_df, val_df = train_test_split(
    train_df, test_size=0.1, stratify=train_df["diagnosis"], random_state=42
)

# Enhanced augmentations with CLAHE
train_transform = A.Compose(
    [
        A.Resize(IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE),
        A.CLAHE(p=0.5),
        A.HorizontalFlip(p=0.5),
        A.VerticalFlip(p=0.5),
        A.RandomRotate90(p=0.5),
        A.ShiftScaleRotate(shift_limit=0.1, scale_limit=0.15, rotate_limit=25, p=0.5),
        A.RandomBrightnessContrast(p=0.5, brightness_limit=0.3, contrast_limit=0.3),
        A.HueSaturationValue(
            p=0.5, hue_shift_limit=20, sat_shift_limit=30, val_shift_limit=20
        ),
        A.CoarseDropout(p=0.5, max_holes=10, max_height=48, max_width=48),
        A.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
        ToTensorV2(),
    ]
)

test_transform = A.Compose(
    [
        A.Resize(IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE),
        A.CLAHE(p=1.0),
        A.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
        ToTensorV2(),
    ]
)


class RetinaDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, img_dir, transform=None, is_test=False):
        self.df = df
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.is_test = is_test

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_name = f"{self.img_dir}/{self.df.iloc[idx]['id_code']}.png"
        image = np.array(Image.open(img_name).convert("RGB"))

        if self.transform:
            augmented = self.transform(image=image)
            image = augmented["image"]

        if self.is_test:
            return image

        label = self.df.iloc[idx]["diagnosis"]
        targets = torch.tensor([label > k for k in range(4)], dtype=torch.float32)
        return image, targets, label

)

)

pos_weights = []
for k in range(4):
    pos = (train_df["diagnosis"] > k).sum()
    neg = len(train_df) - pos
    pos_weights.append(neg / (pos + 1e-7))
pos_weights = torch.tensor(pos_weights, dtype=torch.float32).to(device)
criterion = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss(pos_weight=pos_weights)

# Optimizer with weight decay
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=5e-5, weight_decay=1e-4)
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(
    optimizer, T_0=10, T_mult=1, eta_min=1e-6
)
scaler = GradScaler()

# Training loop with mixed precision
best_kappa = -1
for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    model.train()
    for images, targets, _ in train_loader:
        images, targets = images.to(device), targets.to(device)

        with autocast():
            outputs = model(images)
            loss = criterion(outputs, targets)

        scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
        nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 3.0)
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        scheduler.step()

    with torch.no_grad():

    if kappa > best_kappa:
        best_kappa = kappa
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pth")

model.eval()
